plan: CODE PLAN/COST_BASIS_FOP_STANDALONE_PLAN.md §5.2 (归属表), §8.1 (种类白名单与字段规则)
description: Every kind in cost_basis_events is either allowed in a FOP ledger (with its field rules and where its cash and fees count) or rejected. The contract test fails on an undecided kind.

rules.nonzero_integer: An integer other than 0; buys positive, sells negative.
rules.closing_integer: A non-zero integer whose sign closes the open position.
rules.delivery: A non-zero integer: the FUT delta of plan §6.1, |value| = |contracts| x deliverableFuturesPerOption.
rules.finite: Any finite number, zero and negative included (plan §6.4).
rules.strike: The option contract's strike (> 0 in the first release).
rules.reference_or_null: The baseline reference price, or null when unknown. Only a FOP baseline may be unknown; a FUT baseline needs a trade cost or a reference price (plan §9.2, protocol.json domainRules unknown_cost_only_for_options).
rules.premium_minus_fees: -contracts x premiumMultiplier x price - fees; a different statement cash wins and sets derived_mismatch.
rules.fee_cash: Negative; positive only when the details mark a refund.
rules.evidenced_amount: A non-zero amount backed by evidence.

counts.cash: none: notional stays out of cash

counts.sellerLens: short part: Rs when closed, open short income while open; long part: none
fees in Es; the short premium moves into Rs

short: fees in Es and premium into Rs; long: none
none; O_B offsets the baseline value (plan §9.2)
